ranked_facts.concept_key: Hypercellular marrow with plasma cell atypia and light-chain restriction
ranked_facts.why: The presence of hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells showing atypical morphology and κ-light-chain restriction is highly suggestive of a paraproteinemic disorder, specifically multiple myeloma, and is not typically seen in vasculitic or inflammatory disorders.

Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels are characteristic of cryoglobulinemic vasculitis, and while they can be seen in other conditions, the combination of clinical and laboratory findings in this case makes cryoglobulinemic vasculitis a more likely diagnosis than multiple myeloma or an inflammatory disorder.
